n7nk: Fade out, turn around, come back.

pqxk: Seconds and strength change them: bounce again, 1.6 seconds and half again as high.
q9f1: 3. loop: repeats until stop (or hide, or the next scene). A new loop replaces the old one.
lwym: I am swaying. This lasts across lines.
snj2: Now bobbing quickly, and that replaced the sway.
ciig: Pulsing. A one-shot adds to a loop, so watch.
kase: 4. nowait: start an animation and carry on, so several characters move together.
ah9s: 5. rig.json animations: keyframes of your own. Mina has wave, giggle and head_tilt.
rukz: Still giggling, while I talk. A rig animation can also be stretched: animate mina wave 3.
woaw: 6. part=: one part of a layered character, about its pivot (rig.json "pivots").
sn9t: head_tilt is keyframes that move my face, bangs, eyes, mouth and hair together.
pit0: part= plays any animation on one part: my hair sways by itself.
juzh: And my face nods, while the hair carries on.
odat: 7. idle, speak and blink: nothing in the script asks for these.
k1la: Watch my mouth while I talk, a longer sentence helps: it moves while the letters appear, and stops when the line is done.
w2b5: Eyes closed on purpose: a slot set in the script wins over blinking.
feof: That is all of them. Reduce motion (Options) turns the loops, shakes and hops off.
